proposals.name: HEMA (Historical European Martial Arts) Enthusiasts
proposals.buyer_persona: Adults practicing historical fencing, medieval combat, and weapon arts. They value historical accuracy, technical treatises (Lichtenauer, Fiore), and insider terminology (Zwerchhau, Meisterhau).
product_angles: Humorous stickers about sword maintenance, safety gear smell, and historical treatise debates (Redbubble)
proposals.first_test_product: HEMA Sparring Journal & Fight Logbook with minimal historical cover art (KDP)

proposals.name: Isopod Breeders & Bioactive Terrarium Keepers
proposals.buyer_persona: Exotic pet keepers specializing in rare isopods (Rubber Ducky, Dairy Cow) and bioactive enclosures. They treat these micro-fauna like high-end collectibles and spend heavily on aesthetic setups.
product_angles: High-definition watercolor-style stickers of rare isopod species (Redbubble via FLUX-schnell)
Breeding logbooks and enclosure maintenance planners (KDP)
Infographic posters detailing clean-up crew roles in vivariums
proposals.first_test_product: Isopod Breeding Log & Colony Health Tracker (KDP)

proposals.name: Actuarial Science & Risk Management Professionals
proposals.buyer_persona: Highly paid math professionals studying for grueling credentialing exams (SOA/CAS) or working in risk assessment. They appreciate dark, self-deprecating humor about probability, mortality tables, and Excel.
product_angles: Exam study planners and formula summary notebooks (KDP)
Minimalist typography mugs and stickers with niche actuarial humor (Redbubble)
Cheat-sheet desk mats featuring probability distributions
proposals.first_test_product: Actuarial Exam Study Tracker & Formula Journal (KDP)

proposals.name: Godot Engine 2D/3D Solo Game Developers
proposals.buyer_persona: Indie game developers migrating from Unity to Godot. They work with tight budgets, lack artistic skills, and need modular, ready-to-use visual assets that fit seamlessly into their code.
product_angles: Seamless isometric tilemaps generated via FLUX and sliced/packaged (Cults3D/Itch.io)
User Interface (UI) asset kits with cyber, fantasy, or sci-fi themes (Cults3D/Itch.io)
Game design planning workbooks with wireframe grids (KDP)
proposals.first_test_product: 2D Isometric Sci-Fi Tilemap Asset Pack (Itch.io/Cults3D via GitHub Actions slicing)

proposals.name: Amateur Radio (Ham Radio) Operators
proposals.buyer_persona: Technical hobbyists, often older, who build antennas and communicate globally via radio waves. They are obsessed with signal logs, QSL confirmation cards, and technical certifications.
product_angles: High-density Radio Contact Logbooks (KDP - highly specific layout required)
Schematic-style designs of classic rigs, antennas, and Morse code guides on apparel (Redbubble)
proposals.first_test_product: Ham Radio Operator's Logbook: 120-Page Contact Tracker (KDP)

proposals.name: Local Heritage & Micro-Museums (B2B/White-Label)
proposals.buyer_persona: Curators and volunteers running small regional museums, castles, or historical preservation societies in France. They have zero budget for merchandise design but want to sell local products in their gift shops.
product_angles: Custom coloring books featuring clean line-art of the specific castle or local monument (KDP/Direct Print-on-Demand)
Vintage-style travel posters of minor local landmarks generated via Together AI (Redbubble/Direct drop-shipping)
Historical trivia pocket books tailored to specific regional departments
proposals.first_test_product: Custom Coloring Book for a specific French regional historical association (KDP/Direct)
